about_the_game:
Immerse yourself in the mysterious atmosphere of puzzles and anime aesthetics with the game Halloween Waifu! This is a unique game for puzzle and anime lovers, where a magical night full of secrets, Halloween costumes and charming waifus awaits you.

Game features:

  • 30 levels with unique puzzles

    Each level is a new illustration with anime girls in a Halloween theme - witches, vampires, demonesses and other mystical images. Collect pictures piece by piece and discover all the beauty and charisma of these magical characters. The difficulty increases as you progress — it will be interesting for both beginners and experienced players.

  • Gallery of completed puzzles

    After completing each level, the image is saved in the gallery, where you can review your favorite art at any time. The gallery turns into a personal collection of charming Halloween waifus.

  • Achievement system

    Get rewards for your successes: completing all levels, progress, and completing various tasks. Achievements add motivation and pleasure to the game.

  • Simple and intuitive controls

    The controls are extremely convenient — just drag and drop the puzzle pieces and enjoy the process. Suitable for players of any skill level.

  • Mystical atmosphere and Halloween aesthetics

    The dark color palette, pumpkins, candles, night decorations, and mysterious waifus create a magical mood. Each girl has her own unique image and character — the assembly process becomes especially exciting.

Who is this game for?

Halloween Waifu is the perfect choice for those who love anime, puzzles and the Halloween atmosphere. This game will give you cozy evenings in the company of charming waifus and interesting challenges for your attention and logic.

Collect puzzles, unlock achievements and create your own collection of magical anime girls in Halloween Waifu!
